title: Reset password
description: Full-viewport screen at the end of a password-reset link, composing the login-form block in its reset-password mode: the new password and its confirmation, the rules said out loud as they are met, and the emailed token carried in a hidden input. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm and the footer at @md.
